description: Asks, over the same Bg rows, how a BIGINT column compares and converts: B = the maximum literal, B > the maximum minus one, B = 2^62 + 1 as a literal, as 2^62 + 1 computed, and as a Double; ORDER BY B and B DESC; Min, Max, Count, Sum and Avg; GROUP BY B; and CStr, Str, Format, Hex, CDbl, CDec, CCur, CLng and CInt of B. Each is its own snapshot; the Field type of each result column is read. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
